title: I like this, but , Made in China.
text:
I like this, but , Made in China.. I like this pan, but do NOT Love it.

I like the handle. I can get a good grip with my thin hands.
I think there should have been a Helper Handle on the other side.
It's a bit heavy, and since its a 12 inch pan, it can be clumsy .
It seems to be made good, and it heats up quickly. You do not need to use high heat.

I'm not a fan of this Non-Stick, cause I don't think its healthy. So I called, OXO good grips, to find out more about the non stick in this pan.
I asked if it was plastic, No, and No BPA.
True, cause only plastic has BPA.

They suggest you do not use high heat, She said it wears down the nonstick, then the pan will not last as long.

It says it's,"German-engineered". Which leads one to believe its made in Germany! NO.
When I asked where it was made at, she said,
"Off Shore".Where off shore? Wouldn't tell me, till I insisted. Then admitted its "Made In CHINA"..Big turn off to me !

When I asked other question about the non-stick, she said
It's a Company secret!!! Seriously!!!
I'm cooking / eating out of this pan.
